reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the presenter promotes Forsage by claiming that starting with $20 could lead to hundreds of thousands of dollars and instructs viewers to transfer BNB and BUSD to activate slots. The proposed returns depend on recruiting participants, upgrading paid positions, and repeatedly cycling slots, including turning a $10 slot into $20 and cycling again, although the presenter says spillovers are not guaranteed and denies that creators keep participants’ cryptocurrency.

citations.quote: Again you can start with $20 and potentially get and earn hundreds of thousands of dollars
So it's important to get as many of those personal registrations as possible and teach your team to do the same.
whenever he upgrades to further slots you can continue earning
you can earn extra even without referring anyone just by spillover.
The sooner you upgrade, the more chances you have to have a spillover.

opening.argument: The presentation uses qualified, non-guaranteed language rather than promising a fixed result. The speaker says participants may earn large amounts, describes spillovers as uncertain, and expressly acknowledges that outcomes depend on how many spillovers occur. That framing presents an opportunity with contingencies, not a guaranteed investment return. The speaker also distinguishes the dollar-linked BUSD value from market-price volatility, giving viewers relevant context about the proposed payment token.

citations.quote: potentially get and earn hundreds of thousands of dollars
We can't guarantee how many spillovers are going to happen.
the stablecoin does not change in value

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited recruitment and upgrade language explains how the system is intended to operate; it does not itself prove that earnings are guaranteed or that every participant will profit. The prosecution's own selected evidence includes the explicit qualification that spillovers are not guaranteed. The presentation therefore communicates conditional potential, not certainty.

citations.quote: We can't guarantee how many spillovers are going to happen.
you can miss profits

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The uncertainty disclaimer does not remove the central earnings pitch. The speaker pairs it with urgency to upgrade and claims that people starting with small sums can reach very large returns. Recruitment and paid upgrades are presented as the route to continuing earnings, so calling the result conditional does not change the underlying solicitation.

citations.quote: Again you can start with $20 and potentially get and earn hundreds of thousands of dollars
The sooner you upgrade, the more chances you have to have a spillover.
whenever he upgrades to further slots you can continue earning

opening.argument: The material is structured as a presentation and operational walkthrough. It explains BUSD, Binance Smart Chain, wallet configuration, token addition, and the steps for obtaining BNB and BUSD. The speaker repeatedly frames the activity as showing viewers how the system works and how to prepare for a launch. That instructional format supports treating this as a technology and operational demonstration, even if the presenter also describes his personal experience and the system's possible outcomes.

citations.quote: BUSD Forsage Presentation by Vitaliy Dubinin
there are two ways
how to install Metamask desktop wallet
So that's how you do it. That's how you do it. And get BUSD and prepare for the launch.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The wallet instructions are only one part of the presentation and serve the promoted launch. The speaker does not merely explain blockchain operation: he tells viewers to prepare, activate slots, and join his team. A tutorial format cannot by itself convert a recruitment pitch into neutral education.

citations.quote: prepare for the launch
I'm looking forward to see you in the team
you should transfer BNB and BUSD to activate the slots

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical walkthrough is instrumental, not neutral. It tells viewers how to buy the required assets, move them to a wallet, and activate paid positions in the promoted matrix. Explaining the mechanics in detail does not negate that the instructions are directed toward participation and recruitment.

citations.quote: you should transfer BNB and BUSD to activate the slots
I'm going to buy all of the slots with BUSD
it's important to get as many of those personal registrations as possible

opening.argument: The supplied material does not establish that the presenter or project creators take custody of participants' cryptocurrency, operate a hidden account, or guarantee a return. Instead, the presentation describes a token with a fixed dollar value, transactions on a blockchain, and a smart-contract system in which the creators purportedly do not retain participants' crypto. The claims may be promotional, but the evidence shown is consistent with describing a blockchain-based service and its referral features rather than proving a deceptive custody mechanism.

citations.quote: the project creators never ever take or keep any of the people's cryptos
The project is 100% decentralized
everything transparent, you'll see everything on the blockchain of Binance
busd the stablecoin does not change in value

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution need not show creator custody to identify the promoted model. Its own quotes describe personal registrations, participant upgrades, and spillover earnings. Those are not ordinary retail purchases merely because the system uses blockchain terminology or denies that creators keep the funds.

citations.quote: get as many of those personal registrations as possible
whenever he upgrades to further slots you can continue earning
you can earn extra even without referring anyone just by spillover

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-custody point is beside the issue. The proposed mechanism itself requires paid slots, participant placement, referrals, upgrades, and recycling. The speaker explicitly tells viewers that a lower partner can miss a payment when a slot is inactive, showing that payments are tied to the tiered matrix rather than to an ordinary product or service sale.

because you didn't have the slot active it will pass to the next higher partner
